scope: Component measurements on copies of an existing 100000-row analysis database, not an A7 acceptance run

container.code: Existing image with temporary source overlay for each comparison

input.note: Generated source CSV behind the copied 100000-row analysis database

peak_memory.note: The component harness did not record peak memory; completed runs stayed within the container limit, so no peak value is claimed

resolution.method: Copy SQLite state, clear only copied resolution bindings/cohorts/progress, resolve all accepted observations and build the complete canonical snapshot
resolution.change: Batch indexed tests for uncontested anchors and batch cohort reads; conflicting, ambiguous and weak evidence retains full matching
resolution.limitations: Sequential component comparisons show storage/cache variability; these timings do not establish complete-file throughput, and the harness captured no peak-memory readings

keyed_index_preparation.method: Stream decoded observations from the copied analysis family, prepare each with a cycling provider, hash complete serialized results; timing includes database reads and decryption
keyed_index_preparation.limitations: A preparation-only comparison, not a complete pipeline result; mostly unique observations without repeating providers showed no speedup

compact_payloads.method: Exclude schema-default values only inside encrypted payloads; retain full canonical serialization for identity digests and checkpoints
compact_payloads.limitations: The final compatibility run was slower than the earlier component comparisons; complete pipeline performance must be measured afresh rather than inferred from isolated improvements
